files.data/purchase_alternative_demo.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>
    <data noupdate="1">
        <!-- Call to Tender, i.e. linked RFQs -->
        <!-- Note that forcecreate="0" is added to this demo data due to product type being updated to 'product'
            by stock, but upgrade issue will occur since 'product' type won't exist yet in purchase when trying
            to add the new PO lines (i.e. stock product type update won't exist yet, but it will be in the db) -->
        <record id="rfq3" model="purchase.order" forcecreate="0">
            <field name="partner_id" ref="base.res_partner_1"/>
            <field name="user_id" ref="base.user_admin"/>
        </record>
        <record id="rfq3_line" model="purchase.order.line" forcecreate="0">
            <field name="order_id" ref="rfq3"/>
            <field name="date_planned" eval="time.strftime('%Y-%m-10')"/>
            <field name="product_id" ref="product.product_product_13"/>
            <field name="uom_id" ref="uom.product_uom_unit"/>
            <field name="price_unit">100</field>
            <field name="product_qty">5</field>
        </record>

        <record id="rfq4" model="purchase.order" forcecreate="0">
            <field name="partner_id" ref="base.res_partner_2"/>
            <field name="user_id" ref="base.user_admin"/>
        </record>
        <record id="rfq4_line" model="purchase.order.line" forcecreate="0">
            <field name="order_id" ref="rfq4"/>
            <field name="date_planned" eval="time.strftime('%Y-%m-15')"/>
            <field name="product_id" ref="product.product_product_13"/>
            <field name="uom_id" ref="uom.product_uom_unit"/>
            <field name="price_unit">120</field>
            <field name="product_qty">4</field>
        </record>
        <record id="rfq_group" model="purchase.order.group" forcecreate="0">
            <field name="order_ids" eval="[Command.set([ref('purchase_alternative.rfq3'), ref('purchase_alternative.rfq4')])]"/>
        </record>
    </data>
</odoo>

files.wizard/purchase_alternative_create.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>
    <data>
        <record id="purchase_alternative_create_form" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">Create Alternative</field>
            <field name="model">purchase.alternative.create</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="Create Alternative">
                    <group>
                        <field name="origin_po_id" invisible="1"/> <!-- Invisible fields -->
                        <group>
                            <field name="partner_ids" widget="many2many_tags" />
                            <field name="copy_products"/>
                        </group>
                        <group groups="purchase.group_warning_purchase" invisible="purchase_warn_msg == ''">
                            <field name="purchase_warn_msg" decoration-warning="1"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                    <footer>
                        <button name="action_create_alternative" string="Create Alternative" data-hotkey="q" type="object" colspan="1" class="btn-primary"/>
                        <button data-hotkey="x" special="cancel" colspan="1" class="btn-secondary"/>
                    </footer>
                </form>
            </field>
        </record>
    </data>
</odoo>
files.wizard/purchase_alternative_warning.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>
    <data>
        <record id="purchase_alternative_warning_form" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">Alternative Warning</field>
            <field name="model">purchase.alternative.warning</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="Alternative Warning">
                    <field name="alternative_po_ids" nolabel="1" readonly="1">
                        <list create="0" delete="0" edit="0">
                            <field name="currency_id" column_invisible="1"/> <!-- Invisible fields -->
                            <field name="partner_id" readonly="state in ['cancel', 'purchase']"/>
                            <field name="name" string="Reference"/>
                            <field name="date_planned"/>
                            <field name="amount_total"/>
                            <field name="state"/>
                        </list>
                    </field>
                    <footer>
                        <button name="action_cancel_alternatives" string="Cancel Alternatives" data-hotkey="q" type="object" colspan="1" class="btn-primary"/>
                        <button name="action_keep_alternatives" string="Keep Alternatives" data-hotkey="w" type="object" colspan="1" class="btn-primary"/>
                        <button data-hotkey="x" special="cancel" colspan="1" class="btn-secondary"/>
                    </footer>
                </form>
            </field>
        </record>
    </data>
</odoo>

#. module: purchase_alternative
#: model:ir.module.module,description:base.module_purchase_alternative
msgid ""
"\n"
"This module allows you to manage your Purchase Alternative.\n"
"===========================================================\n"
"\n"
"It helps users compare product lines across RFQs and decide to order "
"specific products\n"
"from different vendors, enabling more flexible and cost-effective purchasing "
"decisions.\n"
"create a call for tender by adding alternative requests for quotation to "
"different vendors.\n"
"Make your choice by selecting the best combination of lead time, OTD and/or "
"total amount.\n"
"By comparing product lines you can also decide to order some products from\n"
"one vendor and others from another vendor.\n"
msgstr ""
"\n"
"Este módulo permite gestionar las alternativas de compra.\n"
"\n"
"===========================================================\n"
"\n"
"Ayuda a los usuarios a comparar las líneas de productos de las solicitudes "
"de cotización y decidir qué productos ordenar\n"
"a distintos proveedores, con decisiones de compra más flexibles y con mejor "
"costo.\n"
"Crea una licitación al agregar solicitudes de cotización alternativas para "
"varios proveedores.\n"
"Elige la mejor combinación según plazo de entrega, entrega esperada o "
"importe total.\n"
"Al comparar líneas de producto, también puedes decidir ordenar algunos "
"productos\n"
"a un proveedor y otros a otro proveedor.\n"

"\n"
"This module allows you to manage your Purchase Alternative.\n"
"===========================================================\n"
"\n"
"It helps users compare product lines across RFQs and decide to order "
"specific products\n"
"from different vendors, enabling more flexible and cost-effective purchasing "
"decisions.\n"
"create a call for tender by adding alternative requests for quotation to "
"different vendors.\n"
"Make your choice by selecting the best combination of lead time, OTD and/or "
"total amount.\n"
"By comparing product lines you can also decide to order some products from\n"
"one vendor and others from another vendor.\n"

files.views/purchase_views.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<odoo>
    <record id="purchase_order_form" model="ir.ui.view">
        <field name="name">purchase.order.view.form.inherit.purchase.alternative.stock</field>
        <field name="model">purchase.order</field>
        <field name="inherit_id" ref="purchase_alternative.purchase_order_form"/>
        <field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//page[@name='alternative_pos']//field[@name='alternative_po_ids']//field[@name='partner_id']" position="after">
                <field name='on_time_rate_perc' widget="percentage" invisible="on_time_rate_perc < 0"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>
    </record>

    <record id="purchase_order_line_view_compare_list" model="ir.ui.view">
        <field name="name">purchase.order.line.view.list.purchase.alternative.stock</field>
        <field name="model">purchase.order.line</field>
        <field name="inherit_id" ref="purchase_alternative.purchase_order_line_view_compare_list"/>
        <field name="arch" type="xml">
            <field name="partner_id" position="after">
